title: ACDK environment file
description: environments/common.json or environments/<env>.json. The environment file is merged over common.json; stackName must be set in one of them. Keys not listed here are your own settings, referenced from resource files with ${env.<path>}.

tags.description: Tags added to every resource in the stack.

regionOverrides.description: Values that differ by region (e.g. ECR image URIs, certificate ARNs). For each region, its object is merged over the rest of the environment when building that region's template.
